summary: Authored sections/kik-why-pococo-section.liquid as a static centered-heading + 4-column feature card row. Desktop renders one row of 4 equal-width cards via flex+md:flex-row+md:flex-1 (gap-xl=32, py-section-lg=96, px-page=64); mobile stacks via flex-col (gap-xl=24, py-section-lg=48, px-page=16). Section heading is centered (max-w-[592px]) using text-h2 (Satoshi); subheading uses text-body-md text-tertiary. Each card is bg-surface, rounded-[12px], p-lg, with a 296/187-aspect image, h5 title, and body-md description. Settings derived from content structure: section-level aria_label, heading, body; per-card blocks expose image, image_mobile, alt, title, body. All 4 unique REST asset candidates were uploaded to Shopify Files via POST /v1/sync-jobs (job cmoxs8aov0001m2krxru8pxo5, all assets status=uploaded) and bound to the four feature_card image_picker settings as shopify://shop_images/<filename>.png. Storefront-render preview verified via make verify-section-preview (status=passed, mode=storefront-render; all 25 measured Figma node ids per breakpoint matched data-kik-region annotations). Geometry deltas were demoted to geometryWarnings under the documented font-fallback heuristic because the project has not yet loaded Satoshi/Funnel Sans webfonts (developer-deferred per skills/theme/figma-first/SKILL.md). Three precondition edits were authorized by the user as out-of-scope but blocking: (a) lowered kik-hero-section autoplay_delay range max from 10000 to 9500 to unblock the Shopify schema validator; (b) switched image_picker setting URLs from shopify://files/ to shopify://shop_images/ — the form Shopify CLI's image_picker validator accepts; (c) added missing token aliases --color-tertiary, --color-disable, --color-star to src/input.css @theme inline so utility-first markup uses text-tertiary / bg-alt-2 / etc. instead of arbitrary text-[var(--kik-color-text-tertiary)] (declared as a shared-style exception below). Layout was implemented with flex+md:flex-row instead of grid+md:grid-cols-4 because Dawn theme's base.css ships an unlayered .grid { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap } rule that wins over Tailwind v4's @layer utilities .grid { display: grid }; flex utilities are not collided.

implementationDecision.sharedStyleExceptionReason: Added --color-tertiary, --color-disable, --color-star aliases to the @theme inline block in src/input.css so existing kik color tokens (--kik-color-text-tertiary, --kik-color-text-disable, --kik-color-bg-star) are exposed as Tailwind utilities (text-tertiary / text-disable / bg-star). Without this, every section would have to fall back to arbitrary text-[var(--kik-color-text-tertiary)] forms, which the kik profile rule 'Use concise theme aliases instead of arbitrary var(...) utilities' explicitly forbids. The aliases are project-wide infrastructure, not section-private CSS — they would have been added by initialize-page-from-figma if it had captured them upfront.

openIssues: DAWN_GRID_CLASS_COLLISION: Dawn's templates/kik-theme-init scaffold ships base.css with an unlayered `.grid { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap }` rule that wins over Tailwind v4's `@layer utilities .grid { display: grid }`. Any future section that wants Tailwind grid layout in this theme must either (a) use flex+flex-row+flex-1 like this section does, (b) use arbitrary `[display:grid]` with `!important`, or (c) move Dawn's .grid into a CSS layer. Recommend the harness/upstream owner adds a layered or scoped wrapping in base.css so Tailwind utilities aren't silently overridden — but that is a theme-wide concern outside this section.

FONT_FALLBACK_GEOMETRY_WARNINGS: verify-section-preview demoted desktop heading geometry deltas to geometryWarnings (heading observedHeight/expectedHeight ratio 6.4×) under the documented font-fallback heuristic in skills/theme/figma-first/SKILL.md — the project has not yet loaded Satoshi (heading) and Funnel Sans (body) webfonts, so the system fallback renders text on a different number of lines than Figma. Webfont acquisition is the developer's deferred responsibility per the skill; once Satoshi/Funnel Sans are wired in, the heuristic will stop demoting and any remaining true geometry deltas will surface as failureReasons.

OUT_OF_SCOPE_PRECONDITION_FIX: per the skill's 'Work on this section only' rule, this section subagent edited sections/kik-hero-section.liquid (autoplay_delay range max 10000→9500) and src/input.css (added 3 token aliases).
